text:
If you've still got evening plans by the water, tonight looks easy: clouds building overnight, a light east breeze, and lows settling near 61. Sunset's already behind us, but with waves at a foot or less and the lake sitting at a pleasant 74, it's a fine last stretch of daylight to be out there.

Wednesday's the day to watch a little. A weak cold front slides through and brings a chance of showers and thunderstorms, mainly noon into the afternoon, with a high near 81. NWS has it at 50-50, and the models are split too, with the American model barely wetting the ground while the European model leans much soggier. I'd bet on scattered, hit-or-miss activity rather than an all-day washout, but I wouldn't plan an afternoon picnic without a backup. Good news beyond that: the front clears out and seasonable, mostly dry weather takes over the rest of the week. Get outside tonight while it's calm, and keep the rain jacket handy for Wednesday afternoon just in case.
